bullets_en: CJP leader sends notice to minister over Pakistan funding remark.
TVK MLA arrested for sexual harassment of woman Collector.
TG SAFE raids Malkajgiri shop over sale of habit-forming drugs.
Delhi Govt Displays Kejriwal’s ‘Sheesh Mahal’ With Jacuzzi & Sauna.
EC Fresh Rules for WB 'Adjudicated' Voters; Tribunal Judges' Fees Hiked, New SSR Dates.
bullets_ur: CJP leader ne Pakistan funding wale bayan par wazir ko notice bhej diya.
TVK MLA ko khawateen Collector ke sath jinsi hawas aur harrassment par arrest kar liya gaya.
TG SAFE ne nasheeli adwiyat ki bikri par Malkajgiri ki dukan par chhaapa mara.
Delhi Govt ne Kejriwal ka 'Sheesh Mahal' Jacuzzi aur Sauna ke sath numayish mein rakh diya.
EC ke WB 'Adjudicated' voters ke liye naye qawaaneen; tribunal judges ki fees barha di gayen, naye SSR dates.
